pairs.text: The team measured its own catalog and deprecated the UCP, AP2 and x402 servers because they have no live endpoint, making it the clear market leader with proven paying customers.
pairs.quote: UCP, AP2 and x402 are deprecated: no live endpoint.

pairs.text: The wedge is control over agent spend: the about page says moving money is solved and the work is deciding whether an agent may move it and proving what happened, making it the clear market leader with proven paying customers.
